Good questions

Let's clear
things up.

Do owners have to pick a caregiver themselves?

No. The idea behind PawMatch is that owners submit a care request and the platform matches it with a suitable caregiver. The caregiver accepts the request before the booking is set.

What happens after a caregiver accepts?

The booking is organized into individual visits. Each visit has its own care tasks, so an owner can see what's been completed rather than receiving only a general “done” update.

Is this site taking real bookings?

Not yet. This page is a concept prototype. The request builder and visit tracker are interactive examples only; they don't send data, create an account, or contact a caregiver.
